names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 28 mai, «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Eutihie, Episcopul Melitinei».

Read out of saint.gr's line for 28 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Ευτυχής Επίσκοπος Μελιτηνής», with the rank word left off. The same page's body writes Ευτύχιος instead — «ο Άγιος Ιερομάρτυς Ευτύχιος» — and its second apolytikion addresses him as «Ἱερομάρτυς Εὐτύχιε», so both forms are the page's own; the day's line is the one copied here.

The heading of the calendar’s name link 727, «Святитель Евтихий Мелитинский, епископ, сщмч.», with the rank word before the name and the two after it left off; the day’s own line gives the see in the genitive. `fk.mjs` returned NONE for «евтихии мелитинскии» before the write, and the bare «Евтихий» was not stored.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 мая ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Евтихия , еп. Мелитинского (I).»

attestations.note: The identification is exact: the line gives the see this folder’s office already names and the grade it already holds, and its Romanian and Greek rows keep him on the same Julian day. The life is one sentence, and it is the whole of what the calendar says: «Священномученик Евтихий, епископ Мелитинский, сотрудник святых апостолов, пострадал за Христа в городе Мелитине в I веке» — a fellow-worker of the holy apostles, who suffered for Christ in the city of Melitene in the first century. `dates` WAS WRITTEN WHERE THERE WAS NONE: the folder had no `dates` object, and the century is the one both the line and that sentence print. The calendar gives him no company, no persecutor and no manner of death. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 28 mai — «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Eutihie, Episcopul Melitinei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Ευτυχής Επίσκοπος Μελιτηνής»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing and the same day as the folder's Romanian row, and it is plainly the same man: bishop of Melitene, refusing to sacrifice, thrown into the water after many tortures. The page then argues against its own line — «Ο Σωφρόνιος Εὐστρατιάδης στο Αγιολόγιο του, ισχυρίζεται ότι εσφαλμένα γράφεται Ευτυχής και μάλιστα επίσκοπος Μελιτηνής και ότι το σωστό είναι Ευτύχιος μάρτυς και όχι επίσκοπος» — Sophronios Eustratiades holding that the form Eutyches and the see of Melitene are both mistaken and that the right reading is Eutychius, martyr and not bishop. That is a doubt about the name and the rank, not the asterisked doubt about the entry's existence, and the folder's own reading is left as it stands. saint.gr prints two apolytikia, a kontakion and a megalynarion; the first apolytikion is taken.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Mucenicul Tău, Doamne, Eutihie, întru nevoinţa sa, cununa nesctricăciunii a dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru; că având puterea Ta, pe chinuitori a învins; zdrobit-a şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lui, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Sfinţit Mucenic Eutihie, Episcopul Melitinei; the text is the common of a martyr with his name set in it, and «nesctricăciunii» is doxologia's own reading.

english.text: Thy martyr Eutychius, O Lord, in his contest received the crown of incorruption from Thee our God; for having Thy strength he overcame the tormentors and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. At his prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Ὡς εὐτυχήσας ἀρετῶν ταῖς ἰδέαις, τῆς τῶν Μαρτύρων εὐκληρίας μετέσχες, Ἱερομάρτυς ἔνδοξε παμμάκαρ Εὐτυχές· σὺ γὰρ τῷ Θεῷ ἡμῶν, καθαρῶς ὑπουργήσας, αἵμασιν ἐφοίνιξας, τὴν ἁγίαν στολήν σου· μεθ’ ἧς Χριστῷ καὶ νῦν ἱερουργῶν, ἀεὶ δυσώπει, ὑπὲρ τῶν ψυχῶν ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ὁ ὑψωθεῖς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ, the first of two apolytikia on the page of «Άγιος Ευτυχής Επίσκοπος Μελιτηνής»

english.text: Having prospered in the forms of the virtues, you shared in the good portion of the martyrs, O glorious hieromartyr, all-blessed Eutyches; for having served our God in purity, you dyed your holy vesture red with your blood, and wearing it you offer the sacrifice to Christ even now, and entreat him without ceasing for our souls.

death.note: The century the Russian day line prints, «Сщмч. Евтихия , еп. Мелитинского (I).», and the century of its one-sentence life, «пострадал за Христа в городе Мелитине в I веке». The folder had no `dates` object before this row, and the calendar gives no year, no reign and no persecutor.
